role: Commissioner, Bureau of Reclamation, U.S. Department of the Interior
stance_basis: memo expresses general concurrence but recommends more definitive noise control provisions
summary: The Commissioner of the Bureau of Reclamation indicated general concurrence with the adequacy of the Draft Environmental Statement for the proposed implementation of Executive Order 11644, but recommended that further consideration be given to noise control provisions. Specifically, the Commissioner suggested replacing the vague phrase 'unusual or excessive noise' with more definitive language to ensure reasonably uniform application.
complaint_summary: The Commissioner of the Bureau of Reclamation generally concurred with the adequacy of the Draft Environmental Statement but recommended that Subsection III of the operating criteria on noise control be strengthened by replacing the vague phrase 'unusual or excessive noise' with more definitive provisions to ensure uniform application.

statement.text: Responses from review in this office and our field offices indicated general concurrence relative to adequacy of the subject statement. We suggest, however, that further consideration be given to Subsection III of the operating criteria pertaining to noise control. Specifically, we suggest more definitive provisions to replace the words "unusual or excessive noise" to insure that reasonably uniform application will be realized.
